title: My Food Day
text:
I like bread and cheese. Every morning I eat two eggs with my breakfast. I also drink a cup of tea. Tea is hot and good for me.

For lunch I eat soup and fish. My favorite fruit is a banana. In the evening my mother makes pasta for the family. We all eat dinner together.

questions.text: What is the writer's favorite fruit?
What can we guess about the writer's mother?
How does the writer probably feel about eating with others?

vocabulary.definition: a food made from flour, water and yeast, baked in an oven
the first meal of the day
a warm liquid food, often with vegetables or meat
a food made from flour and water, often eaten with sauce

paragraph_translations: Lubię chleb i ser. Każdego ranka jem dwa jajka na śniadanie. Piję też filiżankę herbaty. Herbata jest gorąca i dobra dla mnie.
Na obiad jem zupę i rybę. Mój ulubiony owoc to banan. Wieczorem moja mama przygotowuje makaron dla całej rodziny. Wszyscy razem jemy kolację.
